forbidden.subject: other patient records
forbidden.source_text: Patients must never be able to view another patient's medical records.

forbidden.subject: staff clinical dashboard
forbidden.source_text: Non-staff users should never be able to access the staff-only clinical dashboard.

required.subject: appointment scheduling
required.source_text: The patient portal must always provide a way to schedule an appointment.

required.subject: emergency contact information
required.source_text: Patients must not be unable to locate emergency contact information.
